source_snapshot.items: All E1.s NVMe LED Check - Hard drive ready to remove
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert an E1.S NVMe; when it is ready to remove, observe solid white with amber and green off; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: System LED specification defines ready-to-remove as solid white with amber and green off.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; only proposes lsblk/nvme list through insecure SSH, falsely claims no risk and neither creates nor observes removal readiness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires exact vendor readiness trigger, active-stack quiescence, safe state evidence, operator visual proof and no unapproved physical removal.

old_problem: The source defines the final LED combination but not the operation that authoritatively asserts safe removal. Enumeration cannot distinguish ready, ordinary presence or fault disappearance, and guessing an offline/detach path could disrupt an OS, mounted, multipath, RAID or LVM target.
disposition_reason: ED-03/09/10/11/30 prohibit guessing an OEM enclosure/BMC/offline command or acting on an unproven storage target. The missing trigger is core operation semantics, not merely an IP or device number: platform behavior may require OS offline, NVMe detach, enclosure service action, BMC control or another vendor sequence. A complete identity/quiesce/visual/no-pull evidence envelope is defined, but execution and PASS/FAIL remain pending the authoritative trigger, state oracle and recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2216, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2217 / Wistron-HW-00492-V002 / df2aa459cfdc821e was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Define `All E1.s` by a signed bay/population matrix and bind bay/controller/drive serial/model/firmware plus namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID.
Obtain the authoritative vendor ready-to-remove trigger and distinguish it from merely powered, logically offline, fault-disappeared, surprise-removed and physically absent states.
Before any state change, prove the target is not OS/boot/mounted/swap/open-handle/multipath/RAID/LVM/device-mapper/unknown and flush/quiesce I/O under the storage-owner procedure.
Physical removal is not in the stated procedure and remains prohibited unless separately approved; this case stops at ready-state evidence.
Operator photographs the exact simultaneous solid-white, amber-off, green-off combination for the signed stabilization interval; enumeration or disappearance cannot substitute.
Preserve logs/health and stop on identity ambiguity, active use, I/O/media error, device loss outside plan, LED mismatch or physical fault without retry.
No insertion, query, quiesce, offline/detach/enclosure/BMC action, removal, photo, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Vendor-triggered E1.S safe-ready-to-remove state and three-color LED validation
test_case.purpose: Verify every required E1.S bay can place the correctly identified drive into the vendor-defined safe ready-to-remove state and simultaneously display solid white with amber and green extinguished, without data loss or storage/platform fault.
required_package: Signed `All E1.s` bay/population and bay/controller/drive/namespace stable-ID map
Authoritative vendor ready-to-remove trigger, command path and logical state semantics
Solid-white/amber-off/green-off position, simultaneous-state and stabilization oracle
Hot-plug/ESD no-pull boundary, aborts, final state and vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the authoritative vendor readiness trigger and recovery. Once signed, verify stable bay/serial/namespace identity, backup and complete active-stack exclusions; flush and quiesce I/O; execute the exact approved offline/detach/enclosure/BMC readiness action once; prove the specified logical ready state without physical removal; collect full state/health/log evidence while the operator records the exact bay showing solid white with amber and green simultaneously off; restore or leave the drive only per the approved final-state plan.
test_case.expected_result: The exact target reaches the documented safe-ready state through the supported action, has no active references, and the mapped bay simultaneously shows solid white with amber and green off for the signed interval; storage, NVMe, AER, BMC and platform health remain acceptable and final state/recovery succeed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while the trigger/state semantics, target/quiesce proof, LED oracle or recovery are unresolved. After approval, wrong/active target, unsupported or failed transition, unsafe disappearance, active reference, I/O/media/reset error, LED combination/timing mismatch, health fault or failed final state is FAIL. Enumeration, disappearance or one LED channel alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until stable target identity, vendor trigger/state, active-stack exclusions, backup/quiesce, LED oracle, no-pull boundary and recovery are signed.
Protect OS, boot, mounted, swap, multipath, RAID, LVM, device-mapper, open-handle and unknown targets before any state change.
No guessed detach/enclosure/BMC command and no physical pull unless a separate task and authorization explicitly require it.
Stop once on active use, identity drift, I/O/media error, device loss outside plan, LED mismatch or physical fault; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed bay/controller/drive/namespace stable-ID matrix
Vendor-ready trigger specification, exact approved action and recovery contract
Action output/timestamp and post-transition logical ready-state evidence
Per-bay photo/video showing solid white with amber and green simultaneously off
Preserved NVMe/host/BMC/SEL/AER, no-pull/final-state/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, active reference, transition failure, device loss outside plan, I/O/media/health or LED anomaly, stop once and preserve evidence. Do not physically pull or retry. The storage/vendor owner uses the signed reattach/online or enclosure/BMC recovery to restore the approved final state and verifies data/array/platform health.

source_conflict.reason: The unique source consistently defines the ready-to-remove LED combination; the absent vendor trigger is a missing engineering input, not a contradictory identity.

blocked.reason: The safe-removal/LED objective and evidence needs are clear; the missing core vendor transition remains Engineering Decision Pending rather than an intrinsic static-review BLOCKED class.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bay/population and drive/namespace stable-ID map; authoritative vendor ready-to-remove trigger/state/action; backup and all active-stack exclusions; LED simultaneous-state timing; no-pull/final-state boundary, aborts and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING FOR CORE OEM READY-TO-REMOVE COMMAND/STATE/RECOVERY; NO INSERTION, QUERY, QUIESCE, DETACH/ENCLOSURE/BMC ACTION, REMOVAL, PHOTO, RETRY, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Storage/NVMe owner, backplane/enclosure firmware owner and hardware service owner
pending.unlock_condition: Supply and sign the supported vendor readiness trigger, exact state oracle, stable target/quiesce rules and recovery, then re-review; enumeration or guessed detach does not unlock it.

external_authorities.authority: Approved ED-03/ED-09/ED-10/ED-11/ED-30 OEM no-guess, storage-safety, physical handling and no-retry rules
external_authorities.application: Prevents wrong-target/offline/removal actions until the platform's authoritative safe-removal semantics and recovery are known.

project_authority: Storage owner signs target/quiesce; enclosure/vendor owner signs readiness action/state; hardware owner signs LED/no-pull/final state; end engineer owns verdict.
